verdict.rationale: Navan's own pricing page says it lets companies "manage expenses and issue reimbursements," offers receipt scanning for on-the-go expenses, and its API exposes manual expenses and per-transaction activity history. Nothing in the evidence covers the payout method, the speed, or employee-facing status tracking. Missing for 10: direct-deposit payout, any reimbursement-speed ("in days") claim, end-to-end submission-to-payout tracking for the employee, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I can submit an out-of-pocket expense and get reimbursed by direct deposit in days, tracked from submission to payout

citations.quote: Retrieve and update Navan card transactions, Connect card transactions, manual expenses, payroll, repayments
